mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO, EMAIL, NICKNAME, PHONE, MEMBER_STATUS, TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATE_DATE FROM "MEMBER" WHERE DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY MEMBER_NO DESC

SELECT R.REPORT_NO, R.REPORT_TITLE, R.REPORT_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(R.REPORT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REPORT_DATE, R.REPORT_STATUS, R.ADMIN_COMMENT, R.MEMBER_NO, R.TARGET_MEMBER_NO,
M1.NICKNAME AS "reporterNickname", M2.NICKNAME AS "targetNickname"
FROM "REPORT" R JOIN "MEMBER" M1 ON (R.MEMBER_NO = M1.MEMBER_NO) JOIN "MEMBER" M2 ON (R.TARGET_MEMBER_NO = M2.MEMBER_NO) ORDER BY R.REPORT_NO DESC
